seoTitle: Use the Meeting Agenda & Action Items Template
metaDescription: Deploy Smartsheet's Meeting Agenda & Action Items template, assign owners, automate reminders, and track completion with RYG status indicators.
intro: Turning meeting notes into actual accountability starts with the right structure. Smartsheet's Solution Center offers a ready-made Meeting Agenda & Action Items template you can customize with owners, deadlines, and automated reminders. This guide walks through deploying and configuring it.

steps.heading: Find the template in the Solution Center
steps.body: Navigate to the Smartsheet Solution Center and search the template repository for meeting tracking setups.

steps.heading: Deploy the template
steps.body: Launch the Meeting Agenda & Action Items bundle and organize it inside your active workspace directory.

steps.heading: Customize your columns
steps.body: Map your meeting minutes, discussion topics, and target delivery dates into the grid.

steps.heading: Assign owners with Contact List columns
steps.body: Configure a Contact List column type to assign specific action items to team members.

steps.heading: Automate reminders and track status
steps.body: Set up workflows to email reminders as due dates approach, and use RYG status balls and Sheet Summary counters to track overall completion.

faq.question: Where do I find the Meeting Agenda & Action Items template?
faq.answer: It's available in the Smartsheet Solution Center, which you can search directly from your workspace.

faq.question: Can I assign action items to specific people?
faq.answer: Yes, a Contact List column type lets you assign owners and enables resource tracking on action items.

faq.question: Will people get reminded automatically before deadlines?
faq.answer: Yes, automated workflow recipes can email team members reminders as their action items approach the due date.

faq.question: How do I see overall progress at a glance?
faq.answer: RYG status health balls and Sheet Summary counters give you a quick view of completion rates without digging through rows.
